name: One Victoria
headline: Magnificent Manchester
description: One Victoria enjoys a fantastic location close to Manchester's hippest districts and centres of work, only a three-minute walk from Manchester Victoria train and tram terminal. Totalling 129 highly rentable apartments, its sleek interiors are designed to appeal to the city's growing league of young professionals. Comprising two blocks, One East and One West, One Victoria is within easy walking distance of the Northern Quarter, the Central Retail District and the area around Manchester Cathedral known as the Medieval Quarter.
highlightedFeatures: Two blocks: One East (84 apartments over 14 floors) and One West (45 apartments over 10 storeys)
Two- and three-bed apartments have a bathroom to every bedroom
developmentAmenities: Communal landscaped roof garden (10th floor, residents only)
Dedicated reception to both One East and One West blocks
Floating concierge between One East and One West blocks
Video intercom entry system linked to your mobile

specification.heading: Kitchens
items: Brass sockets and switches to the kitchen area

Fully integrated CDA appliances (5-year warranty provided): dishwasher, fridge freezer, oven, induction hob, integrated microwave and wine cooler (wine cooler fitted as standard to two- and three-bed apartments)

specification.heading: Bathrooms
items: Contemporary high quality white three-piece suite
Wall-mounted wash basin and WC with concealed cistern and soft-close seat

specification.heading: Internal Finishes
items: White emulsion to walls and ceilings
Satinwood finish to internal skirtings and architraves

specification.heading: Flooring
items: Amtico flooring laid in a herringbone pattern to the kitchen, living, dining area and hall
Amtico flooring laid in a straight plank to the bedrooms with an inset luxury grey carpet

specification.heading: Electrical
items: Equipment to support provision of BT, Sky Q and Virgin Media in living areas and bedrooms

specification.heading: Sustainability
items: Mechanical ventilation system with heat recovery
Purge vent doors to all apartments

locationNotes: Just north of Manchester City Centre, on the doorstep of the Northern Quarter, the Central Retail District, and the business clusters of Deansgate and Spinningfields. Manchester Victoria train and tram terminal is a 3-minute walk. Manchester Airport is directly connected by train from Manchester Victoria in 28 mins; London Euston is 2hrs 35mins by train. The Medieval Quarter (Manchester Cathedral) is less than a 10-minute walk and Spinningfields is a 15-minute walk.
